apps.title: Modelling Playground
apps.summary: Change the models themselves: drive a population into chaos, click a phase plane to release predators and prey, and simulate colonies going extinct.

apps.title: Front Office Workbench
apps.summary: A front office in your browser: grade any MLB regular against his position, value a contract with an aging curve, see what wins are worth at the gate, and price every seat in a simulated ballpark.

apps.title: Fed Policy Lab
apps.summary: Write your own monetary policy rule and see where it would have set interest rates since 1990, then ask the yield curve how likely a recession is at any horizon.

apps.title: Hospital Command Center
apps.summary: Run a fictional 500-bed health system hour by hour: census by unit and site, Monte Carlo forecasts, weather and surge scenarios, early-warning monitoring of simulated patients, and unit-level finance.

apps.title: Who Pays?
apps.summary: Set a tariff, move the price of crude or merge two rivals, and see how much reaches the price you pay, from Stellar Grove's research on tariffs, gas prices and mergers.

apps.title: Growing Season Planner
apps.summary: Pick a planting date so maize flowers before the heat, put solar panels over a crop, add bees, or plan an intercrop and cover crop, on Songrove Botanicals' simulated case studies.
